current_review.proof_review: Parallel-capacity combination and the strict contact restriction make an active head's total positive input exactly one. The two ordinary-minimum formulas are exact weighted contact-cover identities: every original ideal gives a cover, and the ancestor or descendant construction attains the minimum. Erasing all contacts at that head reduces each cover optimum by at most one. The head has at least two source ancestors, and every erased contact tail has at least two sink descendants, so singleton family minima are unchanged.
